page: Microsoft Azure FX64-16ms_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmsv2 family. It features an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz, configured with 8 physical cores and 16 vCPUs via hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 1344.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory density of 84.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and integrated GPUs, relying on external Premium Storage for disk operations.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2364.0 and a single-threaded text processing score of 2950.0, both placing in the top tier. Single-threaded gzip compression at 34.83 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.28 GB/sec rank in the top 25%. Multi-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 17775.0 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13643.0. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 131.84 GB/sec for read operations and 91.25 GB/sec for write operations.

The server exhibits a high resource-density tradeoff, offering massive memory capacity relative to its 16 vCPUs, which makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require high parallel CPU scaling. The absence of local storage requires network-attached storage configurations. Supported by hardware features like Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512, it is suited for large in-memory databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, and text processing tasks.
